mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns during FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% annualized signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and reduce valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (annualized) for two consecutive months, average 20-day SPX returns are not negative (mean >= 0) or Rank IC over last 5 years is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand across housing and consumer sectors, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) creates tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, compressing profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, average 20-day SPX returns are not negative (mean >= 0) or Rank IC over last 5 years is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.5 (index) indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03, or average 20-day returns when INDPRO > 100.5 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals economic weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through lower economic activity.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 1.0% (annualized), average 60-day SPX returns are not negative (mean >= 0) or Rank IC over last 5 years is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in consumer credit (RSAFS) and employment growth (PAYEMS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand and labor market softness, reducing corporate sales and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS and PAYEMS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term (RSAFS * PAYEMS) is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth exceeding 200k monthly (PAYEMS > 200k) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenues, generating positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03, or average 5-day returns during PAYEMS > 200k periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
